description: Adds Jade tooltip support for MineColonies crops.

mods.name: MineColonies: Jade crops
mods.description:
A lightweight Jade addon for MineColonies.

Track the growth of MineColonies crops directly in your tooltip:
• Growth percentage
• Mature crop detection
• Vanilla-style Jade integration

Designed to feel like a natural extension of Jade itself.

Fast. Simple. Clean.

releases.notes:
Port MineColonies: Jade crops to Forge 1.20.1

- Switch build from NeoGradle to ForgeGradle 6 (Forge 47.4.28, Java 17, Gradle 8.8)
- Jade 11.x API for 1.20.1; MineColonies 1.20.1 deps for the dev runtime
- ModConfigSpec -> ForgeConfigSpec, config registered via ModLoadingContext
- ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath -> new ResourceLocation
- neoforge.mods.toml -> mods.toml, add pack.mcmeta (pack_format 15)
- README updated for Forge 1.20.1, add .gitignore
- Tooltip behaviour, config options and translations unchanged
